description: Live embedded booking form. Fetches the tenant's service menu + 14-day slot availability from /api/v1/public/book/{slug} and POSTs new bookings to the same endpoint, so anything a customer submits here lands in the tenant's /bookings dashboard exactly like a booking placed on the standalone /book/{slug} page. Requires `slug` (the tenant's booking-link slug, usually the tenant subdomain slug).
